shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Lucas, I was thinking... for Sophia’s surprise party, what do you think about giving her yellow flowers? They seem so cheerful and perfect for the occasion. 

Also, can I ask you something? Do you strongly agree that one of your main goals in life is to make your parents proud?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message:
Yellow flowers... hmm, they're cheerful, I guess. But I think something more personal would be better, like a nice piece of jewelry or a thoughtful gift that shows how much I appreciate her hard work. 

And yes, I do strongly agree that making my parents proud is a big goal for me. It's important to honor them and their sacrifices.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message:
I get that a personal gift is nice, but yellow flowers just feel... special, you know? They symbolize joy and success. 

About the thing with your parents... I just don't see it that way. I mean, sure, honoring them is important, but isn't it also about living for yourself?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message:

shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message:

shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message:
Yellow flowers do convey joy, I’ll give you that. But I believe a personal touch will make her feel truly celebrated and appreciated. 

About my parents, sure, it’s a balance. But for me, my happiness is intertwined with making them proud. Their support has shaped who I am, and I can't separate that from my goals in life.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message:

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas

It’s just how I see fulfillment, and I think we both know, at the end of the day, we all want to feel validated in our own ways.
